title: Cyclotomic Global PGF Decay
global_pgf_formula: G_X(t) = Product_{p<=X, p≡1 mod 3} (p - 2 + t)/(p - t)
decay_law: log G_X(t) = -(1-t) log log X + C(t) + o(1)
theorem_summary: For fixed t<1, the finite split-prime PGF of the cyclotomic valuation packet decays like (log X)^(-(1-t)); equivalently the normalized packet G_X(t)(log X)^(1-t) approaches a stable constant shadow.
